title: pros API Bridge Remaining Slices

credential_store.secret_policy: OS credential store only; never log or persist secrets in repo/workspace/profile/allowlist/client config

constraints: PKCE verifier stays in global temp session state
offline_access requires refresh storage and local credential delete support
